{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only the two channels of interest
channel_subset = sales_df[sales_df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])]

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(channel_subset['channel'], channel_subset['customer_segment']))

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_age (bin into groups to avoid too many categories)
channel_subset['age_group'] = pd.cut(channel_subset['customer_age'], bins=[0, 30, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-50', '50+'])
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs age_group:")
print(pd.crosstab(channel_subset['channel'], channel_subset['age_group']))"}
